features.name: recency_zscore
features.description: Standardized recency (months since last donation) to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the recency feature from dominating or being ignored in Euclidean distance computations due to its native scale.

features.name: frequency_zscore
features.description: Standardized frequency (total number of donations) for balanced neighborhood geometry.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aligns the variance of the frequency feature with other dimensions, improving the quality of nearest neighbor retrieval.

features.name: time_zscore
features.description: Standardized time (months since first donation) to normalize the tenure dimension.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures the donor's tenure contributes proportionally to the overall distance metric.

features.name: donation_frequency_rate
features.description: Ratio of total donations to total months since first donation, representing the historical donation rate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a dense, scale-invariant similarity metric that groups donors with similar behavioral cadences regardless of their absolute tenure.

features.name: recency_to_tenure_ratio
features.description: Ratio of months since last donation to total months since first donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights donors who have been inactive for a large portion of their known tenure, creating a distinct geometric cluster for lapsed behavior.

features.name: loyalty_index
features.description: A composite index contrasting normalized frequency against normalized recency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects donors onto a 1D manifold representing overall loyalty, simplifying distance calculations for highly engaged vs. disengaged individuals.

features.name: log_tenure
features.description: Log-transformed months since first donation to compress the long tail of the tenure distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the geometric distortion caused by extreme outliers in the tenure dimension, leading to more robust neighborhoods.

features.name: dist_frequent_donor
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype of a highly frequent, long-term donor (low recency, high frequency, high tenure).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a localized geometric feature that explicitly measures similarity to a specific, well-defined behavioral archetype.

features.name: dist_new_donor
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype of a brand new donor (low recency, low frequency, low tenure).
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the KNN model easily identify and group new individuals by providing a direct distance metric to the origin of the donor lifecycle.

features.name: dist_lapsed_donor
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype of a historically active but currently lapsed donor (high recency, low frequency, high tenure).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a spatial gradient radiating from the lapsed archetype, improving the resolution of the distance metric in that region of the feature space.

features.name: is_first_time_donor
features.description: Binary indicator for individuals who have only donated exactly once.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a hard geometric boundary in the feature space, ensuring first-time donors are tightly clustered together.

features.name: semantic_donor_engagement_level
features.description: Semantic assessment of the donor's overall engagement and reliability based on their recency, frequency, and tenure, mapped to a continuous scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates complex, non-linear behavioral patterns into a smooth numerical scale, providing a high-level similarity dimension for neighborhood retrieval.
